overview: This House resolution assigns Representative McCormick to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, which handles legislation on diplomacy, foreign aid, and international relations. It sets his seniority on the committee to rank immediately after Representative Self. Committee assignments like this are routine House housekeeping. The House adopted it on April 1, 2025.
for: Supporters say filling committee seats lets members contribute to the committee's work and keeps it fully staffed.
against: Critics say it is a routine internal matter that does not change any law, so there is little to debate beyond who is chosen.
